insight: Founded in 2020 in Santiago, Chile and backed by Y Combinator; raised a $15M seed led by Gradient Ventures in 2023.
name: Spline
tagline: Collaborative 3D design in the browser, with AI generation.
description: A browser-based 3D design tool for interactive scenes and web experiences, with Spline AI for generating objects, textures, and animations from prompts. Popular for product and web 3D.
edge: A real collaborative 3D editor for interactive web scenes first, with AI generation bolted on as an accelerator — not a prompt-only toy.
cons: AI generation is secondary to manual editing
